# EXP-2026-11-08-M1.17 — Factory zlib params across non-POINT families

**Date:** 2026-11-08
**Task:** M1.17 — Verify factory zlib params across non-POINT generated file types
**Depends:** M1.13 (C-2570–C-2577)
**Branch / commit:** `task/m1.17-zlib-params-nonpoint` (recovered and re-merged after a coordinator merge error dropped the original branch)
**Status:** done

## Question
Do non-POINT generated/compressed families (ADDRE, ZCODE, ICODE, COORD, LCTBL,
INTER/FRWAY, LEV3456R, MAPAL001 tiles) use the same factory zlib producer as
POINT inner pages (stock zlib L6/memLevel 8, C-2570–C-2571), or do any require
different params?

## Method

### 1. Sample + hash
EU 2011 representative samples (read-only; vendor data not committed). Source
image: `LEAF_2011-2012_QSD-309-101_navi158_eu.img` SHA-256
`105e2032e480e8ba162a2a9d4b6624cb1dafee380379a9908f3f101b15076307` (H21/C-001).
Sample files under extracted EU2011 tree (`leafre-work/m5.20/eu-same/` context);
per-family sample identities/hashes recorded in task run (hashes not re-embedded
for all inner streams here; family/file identity is the factory EU2011 path).

### 2. Runnable commands
```bash
python3 tools/factory_zlib.py --help
python3 tools/factory_zlib.py --selftest
python3 -I tools/factory_zlib.py ...   # outer/inner checks per REFER001 family
python3 tools/lev3456.py verify ...     # EU+US LEV3456R samples
python3 tools/claims_check.py
python3 tools/selftest.py
```
(Exact per-file invocations used the EU2011 extracted tree; see Reproduction.)

### 3. Controls (positive / negative)
- Positive: M1.13 C-2570/C-2571 baseline (POINT 471/471, stock zlib
  release-indistinguishable 1.1.3–1.3.2); `factory_zlib.py --selftest` 25 checks OK.
- Negative: `factory_zlib.py` reported `differs: True` on ADDRE/INTER/FRWAY inner
  page grid searches for non-matching candidates (discriminating), consistent with
  C-2572/C-2573 logic.
- Stock context: zlib **1.3.2**, Python 3.13.17 (H9); compared to 1.1.3–1.3.2
  release-indistinguishable per C-2571.

| `REFER001/FRWAY002` outer | 2 | 2/2 | inner 2/2, grid only `L6m8s0` |
| `RDSTM001/LCTBL001.DAT` embedded (eos) | 517 | 517/517 | plain `.DAT` |
| `MAPAL001/B28R070R.DAT` embedded (eos) | 7937 | 7937/7937 | |
| `MAPAL001/LEV3456R.DAT` s1 L5 strict | EU 62, US 181 | 62/62, 181/181 | `lev3456.py verify` OK |

Totals (losslessly-recovered plain): 1707 outer + 5 inner + 517 LCTBL + 7937 tile
+ 11405 LEV3456R model-matching decoded (incl. 243 strict L5) = **21571**, 0

### 5. Falsifier
Any sampled family/stream requiring different params or failing to reproduce with
stock L6/m8/default/wbits15 when plain is losslessly recovered; to be filed with
characterized byte differences (not guessed). None found in scope.

## Observations
- Stock zlib L6/memLevel 8/default strategy/wbits 15 reproduced every
  losslessly-recovered sampled stream (0 mismatches).
- LEV3456R L3/L4 has `lev3456` model plain-round-trip gaps (EU decoded gaps noted
  in task run) and opaque/model-skipped records; only model-plain-matching decoded
  records were zlib-compared (mismatches in that class = model gap, not param failure).

## Interpretation
The M1.13 POINT finding (C-2570–C-2571) extends to the sampled non-POINT
compressed families: stock zlib L6/m8/default/wbits15 is sufficient for byte-level
reproduction where the plain stream is recovered. This supports keeping
byte-identical/slot-budget assumptions for these families, with the LEV3456R
L3/L4 model-gap caveat (C-2746). Not a proof for all shards/years/section 2.

C-2740–C-2747 (VERIFIED/OBSERVED, scoped); C-2748–C-2749 RESERVED. See
